title: catalog.product.updated
description: The catalog rebuilt a canonical product card after a supplier product was (re)linked to it. Emitted on matching.link.confirmed; consumed by search (indexing) and offer (cache invalidation). Topic: sa.catalog.product, key: canonical_product_id.

canonical_product_id.description: ULID of the canonical (platform) product this card describes.

title.description: Canonical product title, derived from its member supplier products.

brand.description: Canonical brand, if a member carries one.

gtin.description: Representative normalized GTIN-14 of the product, if any member has one.

status.description: Card status. Cards are emitted for confirmed canonicals; 'draft' reserved for future flows.

supplier_product_ids.description: Supplier products currently linked to this canonical (its members).

attributes.description: Merged product attributes aggregated from the member supplier products.

updated_at.description: When the card was last rebuilt (UTC).
